diagnostics.title: Request-log file append failed (log dropped)
diagnostics.summary: Writing a line to the request-log file failed, so that one log line was dropped; each line is written on its own, so the lines after it are still written. Telemetry writes are fire-and-forget and never block serving, but a persistent failure means request logs are being lost — usually a disk-full or permission problem.
diagnostics.action: Check the log file's path for free space and write permission. Serving is unaffected; only request-log durability is.

diagnostics.title: Request-log file open failed (log dropped)
diagnostics.summary: The request-log file could not be opened to write a line, so that one log line was dropped; each line is written on its own, so the lines after it are still tried. A persistent failure means request logs are being lost — usually a missing directory, a permission problem, or a full disk.
diagnostics.action: Ensure the log file's directory exists and is writable, and that the disk is not full. Serving is unaffected; only request-log durability is.
